affordances.name: HatchDensitySlider
affordances.semantic: Slider controlling the frequency multiplier of all hatch patterns

checks.expr: (() => { const hs=["input[type=range]", "label contains 'Hatch Density'"]; const all=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('body *')); const text=(tag,value)=>all.some(el=>(!tag||el.tagName.toLowerCase()===tag)&&String(el.textContent||'').trim().toLowerCase().includes(value.toLowerCase())); return hs.some(raw=>{ const h=String(raw).trim(); if(!h)return false; try { if(document.querySelector(h))return true; } catch {} const id=h.replace(/^#/,''); if(/^[A-Za-z][\w:.-]*$/.test(id)&&document.getElementById(id))return true; const quoted=h.match(/^(?:([a-z]+)\s+)?(?:with\s+)?text\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]$/i)||h.match(/^([a-z]+)\s+labeled\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]$/i); if(quoted&&text((quoted[1]||'').toLowerCase(),quoted[2]))return true; const label=h.match(/^(.*?)(?:\s+button|\s+slider|\s+panel)$/i); return label ? text('',label[1]) : text('',h); }); })()

action.code: let s = document.querySelector('input[type=range]'); if(!s){ document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]').forEach(e => { if(e.closest('label')?.textContent.includes('Density') || e.previousElementSibling?.textContent?.includes('Density') || e.parentElement?.textContent?.includes('Density')) s = e; }); } s.value = 2.5; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true}));

let sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]'); let s = null; sliders.forEach(e => { let ctx = (e.closest('label') || e.parentElement)?.textContent || ''; if(ctx.includes('Thickness')) s = e; }); if(s){ s.value = 3.0; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); }
let sel = document.querySelector('select'); if(sel){ sel.value = 'Minimal'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); }
let sel = document.querySelector('select'); if(sel){ sel.value = 'Dense'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); }

let beforeRot = window.__3D_STATE__.sceneRotationY; window.__beforeRotY = beforeRot; let sliders = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]'); let s = null; sliders.forEach(e => { let ctx = (e.closest('label') || e.parentElement)?.textContent || ''; if(ctx.includes('Rotation') || ctx.includes('Speed')) s = e; }); if(s){ s.value = 0.0; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); }
